title: CricketDAO
tagline: A DAO for cricket fans where members of the DAO control the whole DAO treasury on chain
description: I made this dao for cricket fans. Members of this dao has full control of the DAO treasury. To become a member you need to mint a NFT which is free and member has to lock their NFT to DAO contract. Memebrs can make a proposal and they can vote on proposals. Any member of the DAO can execute the proposals after the proposal deadline.
how_its_made: This project is deployed on polygon mumbai testnet. I wanted to make everything on chain so i had to go through some serious learning curve. Finally i manage to code a on chain NFT and on chain DAO with voting proposals and their execution. I also build the UI for non technical members so that everyone can interact with the DAO.
